_doc: Markings/pattern axis (SPEC_PET_DESIGN_AXES §2) — universal: every animal can bear markings, catalogued or not. Generic words read across surfaces (a spotted bird, a striped snake); surface-specific pattern wording ('barred plumage') is a deferred refinement (§11.4). min_strength DELIBERATELY null (Phase 3, 2026-07-16): at 0.85 every option is live on plainly-marked animals (python, clockwork octopus — patches renders as a charming patchwork, Tier A) and prior-locked on strongly-authored markings (tabby stripes, jay wings) — the §12 Tier B class, the strength slider's territory. Forcing 0.9 here would cost distinctive base details (the octopus lost its clock at 0.9) exactly where 0.85 already works. At 0.9 spotted/tuxedo DO take even on the tabby. clause_slot 20: prefix adjective, outside body's slot 10.
